risks.risk: Bottles may still have caps, labels, or liquid residue (contamination reduces recycling value).
risks.proof: Close-up photo of a sample bag's bottles showing caps/labels removed and bottles empty and rinsed.

Close-up photos of opened bags showing bottle color sorting and whether caps/labels are removed.
